motion.name: email-handoff
motion.purpose: A full-viewport native-dialog scene transforms authored text into masked cipher strips and a locked, faceted parcel moving through seven gates. Receipt is gated on server-side mail-provider acceptance. Dismissal preserves an active request; failure stays an error. Static reduced motion never skips the response. Not real end-to-end encryption or confirmed inbox delivery.

motion.name: email-success-exit
motion.value: 1600ms receipt pause, 550ms lift and mask retraction
motion.purpose: Automatically reveal the form after accepted sending, fading the backdrop and restoring action focus. Confirmation remains in the form; errors and pending requests stay open. Reduced motion keeps the pause and skips the exit movement.

motion.name: hero-portrait-arrival
motion.purpose: An image-ready zoom-out that replays on viewport re-entry, separate from the hero's scroll transform and immediate under reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-scroll-depth
motion.value: scale 1 to 0.9; rotate 0 to -4deg; drift 0 to 72px
motion.purpose: Reversible native-scroll portrait depth after loading; mobile bounds are 0.92, -3deg, and 36px. Static under reduced motion.

motion.name: about-portrait-arrival
motion.purpose: The real cutout lifts 36px, straightens from -2.5 degrees, and settles from scale 0.94; waits for its image, re-arms only fully offscreen, and respects live reduced motion.

motion.name: statement-travel
motion.purpose: Native scroll reveals the complete about statement in the middle of the viewport, clear of the fixed header; static wrapping under reduced motion.

motion.name: metric-count
motion.purpose: Count the four original figures from zero, resetting only fully offscreen without layout shifts or repeated screen-reader announcements; immediate final values under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
An editorial portfolio led by Assier's actual portraits and work. Oversized, open grotesque typography meets warm paper, olive-black project chapters, and an orange close. The interface is expressive without impersonating a terminal, security dashboard, or game.

The selected creative-developer reference sets an interaction-craft ambition, not a template to reproduce. Real photographs and application captures carry the visual proof; normal navigation and readable content remain the foundation.
keyCharacteristics: Portrait-led composition and oversized, medium-weight type.
Sharp image fields, fine separators, and outlined circular or pill actions.
Native-scroll movement with a complete static reduced-motion alternative.
Clear project provenance, deployment status, and direct contact.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Project status is text, not color alone. A local project never inherits a live-demo affordance.

dos: Do use the real portraits and verified project captures.
Do preserve source dates, metrics, links, and explicit deployment status.
Do keep content and controls visible before animation runs.
Do retain the static mobile and reduced-motion reading paths.
donts: Don't introduce fake live links, resume files, availability, or testimonials.
Don't replace the portfolio with a dashboard, game, or repeated icon-card grid.
Don't animate layout dimensions or make essential information hover-only.
